sources.title: CCNL Trasporto Aereo — Parte Specifica Gestori Aeroportuali. Salary tables Art. G20–G22, seniority Art. G23, hourly divisor Art. G28, additional months Art. G29–G30, apprenticeship Art. G14.
Assaeroporti CCNL landing page confirming CNEL code I810 and contract scope (Quadri, Impiegati, Operai delle Aziende di Gestione Aeroportuale).

notes.text: APPRENTICESHIP TRACKS. Art. G14 §16 defines three professionalising tracks (18m, 24m, 36m) with percentage tables by semester. All three are implemented. Art. G14 does not restrict which track applies per destination level; employers and workers choose the duration per PFI. When calling compute() with Apprentice for any covered level, set Apprentice.track to 'professionalizzante_18m', 'professionalizzante_24m', or 'professionalizzante_36m'. Source: CCNL Parte Specifica Gestori Aeroportuali (assaeroporti.com, 04/06/2025), Art. G14 §16 table.

EDR APPRENTICESHIP EXEMPTION. Art. G14 §16 limits the apprenticeship percentage to 'minimi tabellari in vigore, indennità di contingenza'. EDR (Art. G22) is not listed and is therefore paid at full value for apprentices. Modelled via apprenticeship_pct_relevant=false on all EDR allowances.

SENIORITY CAP: maximum_count=8, as per 2025 rinnovo (signed 04/06/2025, FILT-CGIL comunicato) which recognized the 8th scatto from 01/01/2026 for all workers with ≥16 years seniority. Pre-1993 employees with 16+ years already captured under this rule. The engine ages the recognised seniority of the worker (Employment.seniority, a SeniorityFact as of a date), so the 8th biennial scatto matures after 16 years like the others. (review of 2026-10-30)

LEVEL 9 SENIORITY (G23 c. 4, pp. 40-41 of the 2025-2027 text of March 2026): the table of the increments stops at level 8, and none accrues at level 9: the G6 of 4 June 2025 kept a worker at level 9 for 6 months before level 8 (p. 20 of the 2025 text: 'inizialmente assegnato al livello 9 e, dopo 6 mesi di servizio, al livello 8'), short of the biennio of G23 c. 1; the G6 in force from 1 March 2026 (verbale 23 marzo 2026, p. 71) makes level 9 'non utilizzabile ai fini inquadramentali' (p. 82). The amount 0.00 stands.

limitation.remediation: Resolved: level 9 accrues no increment (6 months at level 9 under the 2025 G6, no classification at level 9 from 1 March 2026), read on 2026-11-05.

notes.text: DAILY PRESENCE ALLOWANCES. Artt. G24-G26 pay the sourced rates per stated presence day in regular runs, selected by shift, airport-distance and company-absorption role facts. Art. G24 also contributes to holiday pay from 1 July 2025, but the engine does not yet calculate its holiday-day portion; the daily rate is not paid for those absent days. The amount of the existing company shift allowance that absorbs G25 at SEA and Aeroporto Friuli Venezia Giulia is not stated by this source and is not paid. The G20 one-off of July 2025 precedes the engine window; G27 cash handling and G37 ter DPI are already role allowances.

limitation.remediation: Compute the G24 holiday-day pay for leave taken from July 2025 and source the existing company shift allowance where G25 is absorbed; the regular-run actual-presence daily rates are modelled.

notes.text: ART. G6 RECLASSIFICATION. A supplementary agreement of 23 March 2026 reportedly amended Art. G6 (professional classification). The amendment text was not retrieved; its effect on level codes and salary tables for as_of dates from 2026-03-01 onward is unverified. Hourly divisor taken from Art. G28 text; no official hourly-rate column available in the source for back-calculation cross-check.

limitation.remediation: Retrieve the 23 March 2026 agreement and apply its effect on levels and salary tables.

notes.text: SICKNESS (G34 points 6 and 9-10): hospital days are excluded from both counts and documented oncological illness, multiple sclerosis and muscular dystrophy have triple the overall limit. Certified continuous convalescence after admission (up to 120 days overall) is still counted because its certification and interval are not modelled. The 30% increase for absences attributable to a previously certified disability is not modelled.

limitation.remediation: Add certified continuous post-admission convalescence dates with the 120-day overall cap and documented disability-attributable absence with prior certification for the 30% increase.

notes.text: APPRENTICE SENIORITY (Art. G14 c. 7, p. 31 of the Parte specifica): half of the apprenticeship counts for the aumenti periodici of the confirmed apprentice; no increment during it (seniority_increments.apprentice_amount 0.00).

reviews.scope: The accrual rule of the tredicesima (fractions of a month) against the full CCNL text.
findings: Art. G29 - Tredicesima mensilità (p. 43): "Le frazioni di mese pari o superiori a 15 giorni saranno considerate come mese intero.". Match: at_least 15.

reviews.scope: Artt. G6 and G23 of the 2025-2027 text (PDF pp. 40-41, 71, 82) and G6 of the 2025 text (p. 20), text layer.
findings: Level 9 has no amount in G23 and no worker stays there two years: 6 months under the 2025 G6, no classification at level 9 from 1 March 2026. The 0.00 of the file is the text.

reviews.scope: The monthly values of the levels against the Parte specifica Gestori aeroportuali of 4 June 2025 (text layer).
findings: 66 printed monthly values found verbatim in the text and marked verified; 55 allowance values computed from a clause (maneggio denaro, contributo DPI) are not printed and keep their provenance.

reviews.scope: Artt. G24-G26 daily presence allowances, 2025 and 2026 PDF pp. 41-42, text layers and SHA256 checks.
findings: G24: 2.73 and 3.97 per actual day, both increased by 3.00 from 1 July 2025; excluded from TFR, included in holiday pay from that date.
G25: 0.26 per shift-presence day, absorbed by the existing company allowance at the two named employers. G26: 0.21 up to 20 km and 0.26 beyond 20 km per airport-presence day.

reviews.scope: Art. G34 points 6, 9 and 10, 2025 cached PDF pages 45-46; hospital exclusion and qualifying illnesses.
findings: Point 6 excludes hospital days from both counts and certified continuous convalescence up to 120 days overall.
Point 9 triples the overall limit for documented oncological illness, multiple sclerosis or muscular dystrophy.
Point 10 requires previously attested disability for the 30% increase. Convalescence and disability remain limited.

daily_presence_allowances.description: Daily allowance for actual presence on rotating shifts

source_document.title: CCNL Parte Specifica Gestori Aeroportuali 2025-2027

location.quote: A ciascun dipendente viene corrisposta, per ogni giornata di effettiva presenza al lavoro, una indennità giornaliera di 2,73 euro. A decorrere dal 1° luglio 2025 tale indennità giornaliera verrà incrementata di 3,00 euro.

provenance.transformation: 2.73 + 3.00 = 5.73 EUR per actual presence day on rotating shifts from July 2025; not part of TFR. Leave-pay treatment remains separately limited.

daily_presence_allowances.description: Daily allowance for actual presence outside rotating shifts

source_document.title: CCNL Parte Specifica Gestori Aeroportuali 2025-2027

location.quote: Limitatamente al personale le cui prestazioni non sono regolate da un sistema di turni avvicendati (h16 e h24) e per il quale non trova applicazione quanto previsto al successivo art. G25, la misura giornaliera di cui al precedente comma viene stabilita in euro 3,97. A decorrere dal 1° luglio 2025 tale indennità giornaliera verrà incrementata di 3,00 euro.

provenance.transformation: 3.97 + 3.00 = 6.97 EUR per actual presence day without rotating shifts from July 2025; not part of TFR. Leave-pay treatment remains separately limited.

daily_presence_allowances.description: Rotating-shift daily allowance unless absorbed by an existing company allowance

source_document.title: CCNL Parte Specifica Gestori Aeroportuali 2025-2027

location.section: Art. G25 paragraph 1 and Nota a verbale
location.quote: viene corrisposta una indennità di € 0,26 per ciascuna giornata di presenza. Nota a verbale Per le Società SEA e Aeroporto Friuli Venezia Giulia S.p.A., l'indennità di cui al presente articolo si intende assorbita nella corrispondente indennità aziendale già in atto.

provenance.transformation: 0.26 EUR for each shift presence day unless the employer's existing shift allowance absorbs this amount; the company amount is not sourced.

daily_presence_allowances.description: Airport presence at most 20 km from city centre

source_document.title: CCNL Parte Specifica Gestori Aeroportuali 2025-2027

location.quote: Al personale dipendente che presta servizio in aeroporto viene corrisposta, per ogni giornata di presenza, una indennità di campo nelle seguenti misure: ove l'aeroporto disti fino a km 20 dal centro urbano, € 0,21 giornaliere; ove l'aeroporto disti più di km 20 dal centro urbano, € 0,26 giornaliere.

provenance.transformation: 0.21 EUR per airport presence day for a work site at most 20 km from city centre.

daily_presence_allowances.description: Airport presence more than 20 km from city centre

source_document.title: CCNL Parte Specifica Gestori Aeroportuali 2025-2027

location.quote: Al personale dipendente che presta servizio in aeroporto viene corrisposta, per ogni giornata di presenza, una indennità di campo nelle seguenti misure: ove l'aeroporto disti fino a km 20 dal centro urbano, € 0,21 giornaliere; ove l'aeroporto disti più di km 20 dal centro urbano, € 0,26 giornaliere.

provenance.transformation: 0.26 EUR per airport presence day for a work site more than 20 km from city centre.

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.

provenance.transformation: No increment accrues during the apprenticeship: half of it counts for the aumenti periodici of the confirmed apprentice.
provenance.note: The zero amount is read from the clause, not printed (as Alimentari art. 21, same wording); the credit after confirmation is a caller fact (Employment.seniority).

fixed_allowances.description: Indennità maneggio denaro, Art. G27: 10% of the minimo tabellare and the contingenza of the level

source_document.title: CCNL Trasporto Aereo – Parte Specifica Gestori (Assaeroporti) 2020

location.quote: Il dipendente la cui normale mansione consista nel maneggio di denaro e/o utilizzo di apparecchi elettronici per pagamenti e riscossioni, con responsabilità per errori, anche finanziari, ha diritto ad una indennità in misura pari al 10% del minimo tabellare mensile e dell'indennità di contingenza del livello di appartenenza. 2. Detta indennità non è frazionabile a giorno in presenza di mansione prevalente.

provenance.transformation: 10% of the minimo tabellare (base_salary) and of the contingenza (509.83) of level 9 in force in each period, rounded to the cent; reserved to the role cassiere of Employment.roles (the worker whose normal duty is handling money). A continuous element of the pay.

fixed_allowances.description: Contributo per il lavaggio dei DPI, Art. G37 ter, where the firm offers no washing service

source_document.title: CCNL Trasporto Aereo – Parte Specifica Gestori (Assaeroporti) 2020

location.section: Art. G37 ter - Dispositivi di protezione individuale
location.quote: Salvo che nelle Aziende in cui sia reso disponibile il servizio di lavaggio, a decorrere dal 1° luglio 2025 sarà riconosciuto un contributo di importo mensile pari ad euro 10 lordi, [...] che non inciderà in alcun modo sul calcolo di tutti gli istituti indiretti e differiti, contrattuali e legali.

provenance.transformation: 10 EUR a month from 1 July 2025 to the worker who washes the DPI himself because the firm offers no washing service: the role lavaggio_dpi of Employment.roles. Out of every indirect and deferred institution: no TFR, no extra months.

source_document.title: CCNL Trasporto Aereo – Parte Specifica Gestori (Assaeroporti) 2020

location.quote: Il dipendente la cui normale mansione consista nel maneggio di denaro e/o utilizzo di apparecchi elettronici per pagamenti e riscossioni, con responsabilità per errori, anche finanziari, ha diritto ad una indennità in misura pari al 10% del minimo tabellare mensile e dell'indennità di contingenza del livello di appartenenza. 2. Detta indennità non è frazionabile a giorno in presenza di mansione prevalente.

provenance.transformation: 10% of the minimo tabellare (base_salary) and of the contingenza (524.52) of level 3 in force in each period, rounded to the cent; reserved to the role cassiere of Employment.roles (the worker whose normal duty is handling money). A continuous element of the pay.

fixed_allowances.description: Contributo per il lavaggio dei DPI, Art. G37 ter, where the firm offers no washing service

source_document.title: CCNL Trasporto Aereo – Parte Specifica Gestori (Assaeroporti) 2020

location.section: Art. G37 ter - Dispositivi di protezione individuale
location.quote: Salvo che nelle Aziende in cui sia reso disponibile il servizio di lavaggio, a decorrere dal 1° luglio 2025 sarà riconosciuto un contributo di importo mensile pari ad euro 10 lordi, [...] che non inciderà in alcun modo sul calcolo di tutti gli istituti indiretti e differiti, contrattuali e legali.

provenance.transformation: 10 EUR a month from 1 July 2025 to the worker who washes the DPI himself because the firm offers no washing service: the role lavaggio_dpi of Employment.roles. Out of every indirect and deferred institution: no TFR, no extra months.

location.quote: sia per il periodo di comporto che per gli aspetti retributivi non vengono presi in considerazione i periodi di ricovero ospedaliero; il periodo di convalescenza continuativa successiva al ricovero ospedaliero, anche se trascorso senza ricovero, parimenti non viene preso in considerazione per il periodo di comporto e per gli aspetti retributivi, purché debitamente certificato dal proprio medico di base e a condizione che non superi complessivamente la durata di 120 giorni.

provenance.transformation: Point 6: the sick days of the rolling three years are summed; the whole monthly pay for the first 6 months (183 days), 50% for the next 6, up to the comporto of 12 months (365 days). Stored as a cumulation of one band over a three-year window. Read on 2026-10-30. Exclude hospital days from both counts; for the three documented pathologies in point 9, triple the overall 365-day limit to 1095 days, retaining the original full-pay tier. Convalescence and disability-related limits remain limited.
